question:
The marks obtained by 9 students in a test are: 5, 8, 7, 9, 6, 7, 8, 7, 10.

Determine: (i) Mode of the marks, (ii) Number of students scoring above average.

options.text: Mode = 7, Number of students scoring above average = 3
Mode = 8, Number of students scoring above average = 4
Mode = 8, Number of students scoring above average = 3
Mode = 7, Number of students scoring above average = 4

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

List marks in ascending order: 5, 6, 7, 7, 7, 8, 8, 9, 10.

Mode is the most frequent value ⇒ 7 occurs three times, so Mode = 7.

Average = Sum ÷ Count = 67 ÷ 9 ≈ 7.44.

Marks above 7.44 are 8, 8, 9, 10 ⇒ 4 students.

**∴ The correct answer is Mode = 7, 4 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks of 9 students: 5, 8, 7, 9, 6, 7, 8, 7, 10

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95fe28470be565e654e81b71de49c20815b3aa42152dcfc577033f4d1f01d3af.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of marks = 5 + 8 + 7 + 9 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 7 + 10 = 67

⇒ Total number of students = 9

⇒ Average marks = 67 ÷ 9 ≈ 7.44

⇒ To determine the students above average, observe the marks greater than 7.44: 8, 9, 8, 10.

⇒ Number of students scoring above average = 4

⇒ To find the mode, determine the frequency of each distinct mark:

⇒ Mark 5 occurs 1 time

⇒ Mark 6 occurs 1 time

⇒ Mark 7 occurs 3 times

⇒ Mark 8 occurs 2 times

⇒ Mark 9 occurs 1 time

⇒ Mark 10 occurs 1 time

⇒ The mark with the highest frequency is 7.

⇒ Therefore, Mode = 7

**∴ The correct answer is Mode = 7, 4 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean (Average)

The mean is calculated by adding all the values in a dataset and dividing the sum by the total number of observations. It represents the central point of the data.

Median

The median is the exact middle value of a sorted dataset. For an odd number of observations, it is the center value. For an even number, it is the average of the two central values.

Mode

The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a dataset. A set of data may have one mode (unimodal), multiple modes (multimodal), or no mode if all values occur with the same frequency.
